name: Legora aOS
technical: The agentic operating system that binds seven layers — LLMs, agentic harness, data & integrations, context & knowledge, legal capabilities, products & interfaces, and security & governance — into one system.
prospect: One system rather than a bolt-on tool: the work, the firm's knowledge and the controls all sit in the same place.

name: Agentic Harness
technical: Orchestration layer handling tool routing, control flow, memory management, model selection, and guardrails; deploys specialist sub-agents in parallel for multi-step tasks.
prospect: Multi-step work is split up and run in parallel rather than one prompt at a time.

name: Agent
technical: Execution engine running a plan → execute → review → deliver loop, with autonomous tool selection and output written into the project workspace for human approval.
prospect: Work is planned, carried out and checked, then handed back for a lawyer to approve before it goes anywhere.

name: Skills
technical: Reusable encoded instructions capturing a firm's processes, preferences, and standards, injected into Agent runs so output matches house method.
prospect: The firm's own method and house standards are written down once, so what comes back is already in the firm's way of doing things.

name: Proactivity
technical: Agent monitors email, documents, and projects and triggers action without an explicit prompt.
prospect: It watches the matter, the documents and the inbox, and raises things without being asked.

name: Assistant
technical: Conversational interface over internal and external documents in any language, returning answers with source citations.
prospect: Ask a question across the whole document set, in any language, and get an answer cited to the source.

name: @-mention file referencing
technical: Typing @ in the Assistant opens a picker for documents and Tabular Reviews to scope context.
prospect: Point it at exactly the documents you want it to consider, and nothing else.

name: Voice mode
technical: Speech input to the Assistant as an alternative to typing.
prospect: Dictate instead of typing.

name: Tabular Review
technical: AI spreadsheet where each imported document becomes a row and each natural-language prompt becomes a column; supports format specification, filtering, and sorting. Bulk actions include redlining and export.
prospect: Every document becomes a row and every question a column — hundreds reviewed side by side instead of opened one at a time.

name: TR cell provenance
technical: Each cell expands to show the model's reasoning and the underlying source document.
prospect: Every answer opens up to show the reasoning and the source document it came from.

name: TR collaboration controls
technical: Real-time multi-user editing with Mark as Reviewed, Lock Cells, and Review Mode as workflow guardrails.
prospect: A whole team reviews the same set at once, locking and signing off rows as they go.

name: TR chat / analysis
technical: In-grid chat that creates columns from plain language, answers analytical questions across cells, and calculates values, with cited answers.
prospect: Ask analytical questions across the entire set — counts, comparisons, outliers — and get cited answers back.

name: TR templates
technical: Column sets saved as reusable, shareable templates encoding firm expertise.
prospect: The question set for a recurring review is saved once and reused by everyone who runs it next.

name: Workflows
technical: Agentic multi-step sequences that chain drafting, review, extraction, search, and custom tools into one run. Defined in natural language rather than a no-code node builder.
prospect: A whole sequence — draft, review, extract, check — described in plain English and run end to end in one go.

name: Playbooks
technical: Configurable rule sets defining starting positions, non-negotiables, and fallbacks, authored once in Legora and executed against documents in Word.
prospect: The firm's opening positions, red lines and fallbacks written down once, then applied to every document that comes in.

name: Legal Research
technical: Investigates multiple angles in parallel across jurisdictions, ranks sources by authority, and verifies each finding against primary law before returning it.
prospect: Several angles researched at once across jurisdictions, sources ranked by authority, every point checked against primary law.

name: Citation verification
technical: Every finding links to its primary source, is checked to confirm it still holds, and displays the exact passage in context, hosted on-platform.
prospect: Every point links to primary source, is checked that it still holds, and shows you the passage in context.

name: Web search
technical: Agentic retrieval over publicly available web sources.
prospect: Searches public sources as part of the same piece of work.

name: Database Search
technical: Scoped query against user-selected licensed legal databases, with results used to answer the query.
prospect: Queries the licensed databases the firm already pays for, inside the same piece of work.

name: Deep Research
technical: Slower, higher-depth research mode for more exhaustive analysis.
prospect: A slower, more exhaustive mode for when the question warrants it.

name: Lists
technical: Structured task and fact management: the Agent populates rows from source documents, each with a status, assignee, and link back to the originating clause or paragraph.
prospect: The facts and tasks buried in the documents pulled into a structured list — each row with an owner, a status and a link back to the clause it came from.

name: List templates
technical: Prebuilt structures for closing checklists, chronologies, and prospectus verification across corporate, finance, capital markets, disputes, real estate, and regulatory work; custom lists supported.
prospect: Ready-made structures for closing checklists, chronologies and prospectus verification, rather than rebuilding the same grid each matter.

name: Editor
technical: AI-native drafting surface that converts Tabular Review and Assistant output into full documents with citations back to the underlying data.
prospect: The review turns straight into the finished document, with citations back to the material it rests on.

name: Editor collaboration
technical: Real-time co-editing plus AI-suggested refinements the user accepts or rejects individually.
prospect: Co-edit in real time, taking or leaving each suggested change one at a time.

name: Editor export
technical: Direct export to Word applying firm house styles, avoiding post-export reformatting.
prospect: Comes out in Word in the firm's house style, with no reformatting afterwards.

name: Word Add-In
technical: Side-panel Agent inside Microsoft Word for drafting clauses, proofreading, risk flagging, and redlining without leaving the document. Edits appear as native track changes with citations.
prospect: It works inside Word — drafting, proofreading, flagging risk and redlining — and the edits arrive as ordinary track changes.

name: Word Actions
technical: Fill Template (populate a document from a related source doc), Anonymize (replace names, dates, addresses with placeholders), Improve Writing (rewrite a selection without changing meaning), Translate (DeepL-backed, format-preserving).
prospect: Fill a template from a source document, anonymise names and dates, tighten wording without changing meaning, or translate with the formatting intact.

name: Outlook Add-In
technical: In-inbox Assistant that summarizes long threads and drafts replies, and one-click saves emails and attachments into Legora.
prospect: In the inbox: long threads summarised, replies drafted, and mail filed to the matter in one click.

name: Mobile app
technical: iOS and Android clients with Assistant history synced across devices, plus document Q&A, summarization, and key-point extraction with citations.
prospect: The same thing on a phone, with cited answers on documents wherever you are.

name: Portal
technical: White-labelled, AI-native client workspace requiring no guest license, where firms publish files, Tabular Reviews, and Workflows for clients to run. Underlying prompts, logic, and firm knowledge stay hidden from the guest.
prospect: A branded workspace where the client runs the firm's own reviews themselves — without ever seeing the firm's know-how behind them.

name: Portal collaboration
technical: Shared real-time workspace with role-based access controls and audit trails; clients query shared databases and get grounded, cited answers.
prospect: Client and team in one space, with who-sees-what controls and a record of everything done.

name: Monitors
technical: Continuous horizon scanning scoped to chosen jurisdictions, topics, and sources; items arrive with a summary, metadata, and a link to the original.
prospect: Continuous scanning of the jurisdictions and topics you choose, each item arriving summarised with a link to the original.

name: Monitors triage & act
technical: Filter, prioritise, and assign owners, then compare current law, assess impact, track tasks, and produce deliverables in-platform with an audit trail.
prospect: Changes get an owner, an impact assessment against current law, and a finished client note — with an audit trail.

name: Library
technical: Single location for prompts, templates, playbooks, and workflows.
prospect: Prompts, templates, playbooks and workflows all in one place.

name: Prompt Library
technical: Saved reusable prompts with name, document-scope setting, prompt body, usage instructions, and tags, shareable to individuals, practice groups, or the whole org.
prospect: What one lawyer works out is shared to the practice group or the whole firm, not lost.

name: Projects
technical: Matter-scoped workspaces with instant switching, including Private Projects for personal work.
prospect: Each matter has its own workspace, switched between instantly.

name: Global Search
technical: Search spanning projects, Tabular Reviews, and chats.
prospect: Search across every matter, review and conversation at once.

name: Context & Knowledge layer
technical: Firm playbooks, precedent libraries, clause banks, negotiated positions, and full matter history layered into every agent action so state carries between rounds.
prospect: The firm's precedents, clause banks and previously negotiated positions carry into every round, so nothing restarts from scratch.

name: Data & Integrations
technical: DMS integrations, document ingestion, content sources, third-party legal services, and MCP connectors all feed the agent's context. Includes iManage and SharePoint.
prospect: It works on the documents where they already sit, including iManage and SharePoint.

name: Content partnerships
technical: Licensed primary and secondary law hosted on-platform, covering US federal and all 50 states plus jurisdiction-specific sources (EUR-Lex, EDGAR, FromCounsel, Lovdata, Bundesrecht, and others).
prospect: Licensed primary and secondary law on the platform itself — US federal and all fifty states, plus EUR-Lex, EDGAR, Lovdata and other national sources.

name: Security & Governance
technical: Ethical walls and cross-matter isolation prevent information bleeding across matters, users, or time; full audit trails cover every tool call, file access, and agent action.
prospect: Ethical walls hold: nothing crosses between matters, users or time, and every action leaves an audit trail.

name: Compliance posture
technical: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR, HIPAA, and zero model training on customer data.
prospect: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR and HIPAA — and nothing you put in trains a model.
